title: This phone's Android build hasn't been tested with Omarchy Mobile
body: This phone's bootloader and baseband match Google's build TEST.251201.001, but no Omarchy Mobile release has been tested with that build's firmware, so the installer does not use it.
The list has a newer build that was tested: TEST.260101.001. If Android offers an update to it, install it (Settings > System > System update) and start the installer again.
After an Android update, Android runs from slot B and the two bootloader copies can differ; the installer then stops for that, and the install guide has the way to put Android back on slot A.
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Start the installer again once that is done.
